stateMachines.name: Checkout and sale lifecycle
stateMachines.rollbackBehavior: Before commit, release owned reservations and reverse loyalty authorization; after commit use refunds or compensating facts.
stateMachines.recovery: Query by clientCommandId, replay the same fingerprint, or resume an owned suspended checkout.
stateMachines.timeoutBehavior: Reservation and suspension expiry append explicit expiration/release facts; provider ambiguity enters payment UNKNOWN.

stateMachines.name: Payment intent lifecycle
stateMachines.rollbackBehavior: Void an authorization when supported; captured value is corrected by refund facts, never deletion.
stateMachines.recovery: Query the original provider intent and reconcile settlement/webhook evidence.
stateMachines.timeoutBehavior: Provider timeout or response loss produces UNKNOWN, which is query-only.
invariantChecks: no network call under DB lock

stateMachines.name: Refund lifecycle
stateMachines.rollbackBehavior: Failed preparation releases no value; completed refunds remain append-only and may only receive explicit compensating correction.
stateMachines.recovery: Query the original refund/payment intent and reconcile cash, provider, inventory, and receipt projections.
stateMachines.timeoutBehavior: Approval expiry returns to a new preparation requirement; provider ambiguity enters OUTCOME_UNKNOWN.

stateMachines.name: Physical cash shift lifecycle
stateMachines.rollbackBehavior: Opening failure is atomic; later correction appends movements and transitions rather than rewinding ledger history.
stateMachines.recovery: Reopen with dedicated permission and approval, or force-close with snapshot, reason, alert, and audit.
stateMachines.timeoutBehavior: Inactivity may suspend by policy; pending commands/events block close rather than timing into success.

stateMachines.name: Inventory reservation lifecycle
stateMachines.rollbackBehavior: Checkout cancellation or failure appends release; consumption is corrected through inventory return/refund movements.
stateMachines.recovery: Reconcile reservation by checkout command identity and alert on failed compensation.
stateMachines.timeoutBehavior: TTL expiry appends release and makes a later stale consume conflict.

stateMachines.name: Offline command lifecycle
stateMachines.rollbackBehavior: Commands are never deleted to simulate rollback; explicit resolution or compensating online command is required.
stateMachines.recovery: Query by clientCommandId, replay in device sequence, map provisional IDs, and surface conflicts.
stateMachines.timeoutBehavior: Transport timeout returns to READY with the same command; snapshot expiry or policy rejection becomes explicit conflict/rejection.

stateMachines.name: Device enrollment and trust lifecycle
stateMachines.rollbackBehavior: Failed enrollment consumes no usable authority; retry returns the same enrollment result without redisclosing shared secrets.
stateMachines.recovery: Issue a new bounded challenge, rotate to a new public key, or replace and revoke the old device through audited management.
stateMachines.timeoutBehavior: Enrollment code expires after ten minutes; stale proofs, nonces, and unsupported versions fail closed.
stateMachines.futureUmiOwner: apps/umi-api device trust and client secure storage

stateMachines.name: Operator session lifecycle
stateMachines.rollbackBehavior: Failed authentication grants no session; revocation invalidates subsequent online commands.
stateMachines.recovery: Fresh PIN on a trusted device; active-shift refresh additionally requires valid device proof.
stateMachines.timeoutBehavior: Access token lasts 15 minutes; fresh-PIN evidence lasts five minutes; abuse controls may temporarily lock attempts.

stateMachines.name: Kitchen order lifecycle
stateMachines.rollbackBehavior: Kitchen rejection does not alter payment, cash, loyalty, or inventory; it creates a remediation task.
stateMachines.recovery: Replay actions with expected server version; stale transitions enter reconciliation; provisional IDs map by clientCommandId.
stateMachines.timeoutBehavior: Missing ACK after bounded retry prints one fallback ticket and retains warning/reconciliation state.
